messages:
karen: FYI Simone (Prod Eng) submitted resignation this morning. Last day is 2026-05-08 (Fri). Need to coordinate: benefits termination, COBRA packet/timing, expense card reconciliation, SSO/service deprovision, and laptop return.

ryan_it: On it. Quick question 1: do we cut VPN/Okta at EOD last day or earlier? I usually disable interactive access at 09:00 on final day and revoke keys by EOD unless manager needs extended window.

karen: Hugo prefers handoff window through midday. Please do disable interactive access at 17:00 and revoke non-manager API keys by 18:00.

marta-payroll: Payroll confirmed final pay run on 2026-05-14. For benefits: health coverage stays active through last day (5/8). COBRA election notice should go out 5/9 automatically via our broker. Note: employee has 60 days to elect.

jenna_recruiting: I'll request two 45-min handoff blocks with Hugo and the team next week and add a note template for "critical systems + owners" in the hiring drive. Also marking role "backfill:open - recruiter engaged" but will pause outreach until Hugo approves JD adjustments.

ryan_it: Deprovision checklist I will follow and post to this thread: 
```
- Schedule Okta disable: 2026-05-08 17:00
- Revoke AWS console/API keys, rotate service accounts as needed
- Remove from GitHub org; transfer any repos to Hugo or team-maintainers
- Remove from CI runners and revoke personal SSH keys
- Remove Datadog/monitoring access; ensure on-call rotations updated
- Disable Slack login (archive messages)
- Reclaim MacBook + power adapter; pre-paid return label to be provided
- Revoke third-party app tokens (Sentry, Rollbar, Segment)
```

simone: Thanks everyone 1. I'll confirm home mailing address for the COBRA packet and dependent info by EOD. I can drop the laptop at the UPS store (San Mateo) on Saturday 5/9 if that helps for shipping.

it-bot: [automated] IT ticket created: IT-5590 assigned to ryan_it. Asset return label AR-6602 generated.

marta-payroll: Broker note: COBRA election notice is a mailing + email; mailing address must be confirmed to trigger postal packet. Also note there is a 60-day election/effective retro window; we usually set COBRA effective date as day after coverage end (5/9). I'll DM Simone for address confirmation and dependent SSN redaction guidance.

karen: Reminder: please check any GitHub branch protections and transfer repo admin to Hugo before removal. Jenna, include a short "who owns what" list in the handoff invite.

jenna_recruiting: Will do. Also tagging legal/comp about final equity vest proration if relevant.

ryan_it: I'll post a planned deprovision window once Hugo confirms whether Simone needs a few hours of access on the last day. For now tentatively 09:0017:00 on 2026-05-08.

karen: Great, thanks all. I'll close out after Simone confirms address and payroll posts the final run note.
